$comment: Compliance configuration for the X (Twitter) post generator. Legal/compliance may edit this file without code changes. Every value here is read at runtime by src/social/config.js.
disclosure: Educational market analysis only. Not investment advice. Trading involves risk.
$disclosurePlacement: 'post' = the disclosure line is appended to every post and validated; 'bio' = it lives in the account bio only (set it there!) and posts carry the required hashtags (#NFA #DYOR) as the in-post marker. Flip to 'post' to restore per-post disclosures without a code change.

autoPublish.$comment: Guard-railed unattended publishing (tv social auto). candidateSource 'report-cohort' posts exactly the names the report lists under Calls and Puts (its flow-trend gate is the authority; the classifier only supplies the label and can never upgrade one). Every guard below must hold; nothing here can override the stale-data gate. SOCIAL_AUTO_PUBLISH=0 in the environment is a kill switch.

hashtags.$comment: Required tags are enforced by validation. #Breakout/#Breakdown are added only when the setup name says so (never to upgrade a signal); other engagement tags are appended in priority order while the post fits charLimit.

cta.$comment: Engagement line placed before the Data line; dropped first when the post does not fit charLimit. Set enabled=false to remove.
cta.text: Watching this setup? Bookmark it and follow for daily breakdowns.

charts.$comment: Annotated daily chart attached to every post (candles from Yahoo Finance; levels, price and timestamp from the report). If the chart cannot be built the post goes out text-only and the audit records why. requireForPublish=true blocks instead.
